why: Measured on this arm with the same procedure as arm 1. The numbers differ from its neighbour (pan 1.050 vs 1.059, elbow 0.953 vs 0.976, wrist_flex 0.967 vs 0.94), which is exactly why the server refuses a table measured on another arm.

shoulder_pan.note: five poses over 87 deg on the printed sheet; return to 1 deg
shoulder_pan.deadband_basis: measured 2026-11-21 on so100_cell_b: two 0.5 deg steps and one 1.0 deg step moved nothing from the same pose; 2.0 deg moved 1.495 and 5.0 deg moved 4.308, both short. The threshold is between 1.0 and 2.0, double arm 1's, and this pan undershoots as well — arm 1 moved 1.231 of 1.0 deg where this one moved 0.0. Evidence: docs/qualification/baseline/2026-11-21-deadband/pan_steps_arm2.csv

shoulder_lift.note: taped inclinometer, 30.15 deg span, return within 0.7 deg

elbow_flex.note: magnitude; positive elbow lowers the forearm, so the fit is negative. One pose discarded (level dead zone at the horizontal)

wrist_flex.note: two segments agree to 0.001; the return is 3.5 deg off a 1:1 upstream-drift correction

wrist_roll.note: six points, three each side, read along the axis: +0.837 / -0.806, combined 0.823. The 0.031 gap between directions is backlash (~2.5 deg at 80)

gripper.note: J(mm) = 0.733*pct + 12.4 over 0-50 %: 17 mm at 6 %, 31 at 25, 49 at 50, and 13 mm at 1.8 % closing. No hysteresis seen at 25 % (31 both ways). Arm 1 is 1.35 mm/% and 16 mm closed, so the two jaws need separate curves.
